title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1985-04-07
lineage: Playback of MCs on recording deck (Marantz PMDxxx) > Sony D6 > Maxell XL90s (1st gen). 1st (gen) > Playback on Marantz PRD505 (azimuth adjusted) > Marantz Intergrated Stereo Amp MP-68 > SB Audigy4 on new P4 machine > Sound Forge normalization  > WAV > CDWave > WAVs > Flacfrontend 1.7.1 (level 8) > flacs.

ai_review.summary: Recording suffers from significant pitch problems, making it noticeably flat.
ai_review.review: The tape is out of tune, with the entire performance recorded a full semitone low (and even the soundboard sources are still over a third‑semitone flat). This pitch error dominates the listening experience and overshadows any assessment of the musical performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review focusing on a major pitch issue; no positive comments about the show, leading to a low overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch/speed are significantly off – flat by an entire semitone (SBDs still ~1/3 semitone flat).
